description: A plate with 8 studs whose document declares the `bottom` face up: the studs would stand on the bed, and the exporters lay it bottom down anyway. Two blockers.

findings.fix: set print.up to "top" in the part document, or use relief mode inlay for a face-down print
findings.message: the part document declares the `bottom` face up, but the exporters lay the part bottom down as designed; only an inlay prints face down

findings.fix: use body.tile (a smooth top) for a face-down part, or turn the stud field off with its `if`
findings.message: the part prints face down, but 8 studs stand on that face (a face on the bed has 0): the face must be flat and stud-free

unchecked.reason: no printer or bed was given, so the part was not checked against a build volume; choose a printer (openbrick validate --printer, or the playground's printer menu) or give a bed (--bed WxDxH)
